case: Manually labeled 40-sample two-channel toy waveform at 2000 samples/s with reference at sample 20
independentBasis: Read known generator labels directly: sample 12→A, 16→B, 28→A, 32→B. Subtract sample 20 independently to obtain -8, -4, +8, +12 samples; times are -4, -2, +4, +6 ms. Second trigger at 21 moves every offset by -1 sample. Known centers are -60 µV on A and -45 µV on B, from constructed five-sample pulses.
tolerance: Exact integer sample offsets; within one sample (0.5 ms) for exported alignment. At most 1e-10 ms and µV for ideal deterministic fixture.
